name: Computer Aided Colour Science In Textile Wet Processing

units.title: Fundament als of Colour Science
topics: 1.1. Perception of Colour (Source of light, Object and Observer)
1.2. Colour Mixing: Additive and Subtractive colour mixing, Confusion in Colour (After image, Simultaneous contrast etc.)
uos: 1.b. Explain colour mixing law and confusion in colour

units.title: Theory of Visual Colour Assessment
topics: 2.1. Colour vision Theory (Mechanism of colour vision, Defects of colour vision, colour vision tests, Awareness about colour vision)
2.2. Visual Colour assessment:Variables in visual colour assessment, Standard conditions and methods for Visual assessment
2.3. Colour order System (Munsell, Colour Atlas system, CIE system)
uos: 2.c. Describe various methods for visual assessment

units.title: Basics of computer Aided Colour Science
topics: 3.4. Colour difference and chromaticity diagram, Colour difference equation (CIE), acceptability and perceptibility
uos: 3.a. Explain working principle of colour measuring instruments
3.b. Describe colour difference equation and chromaticity

units.title: Optical Theory for Colour Matching
topics: 4.1. Reflectance curves of dyed specimens Kubelka – Munk Theory
4.2. Application of K – M Theory to Textile
4.3. Optical Theory and colour mixing law
uos: 4.a. Describe reflectance curves of dyed materials
4.b. Explain Kubelka – Munk theory and its application
4.c. Explain colour mixing law with the help of optical theory

units.title: Application of CCM in Wet Processing
topics: 5.1. Implementation of CCM (computer colour matching) techniques for textile
5.3. Limitation and drawbacks of CCM Techniques
5.4. Application of CAD/CAM in textile wet processing. Computer aided Colour Science in Textile Wet Processing Course Code: 3352801 GTU/ NITTTR Bhopal/14-15 Gujarat State 3
uos: 5.b. Describe application of CAD/CAM in Textiles.
